name: iinpublic
description: IinPublic - Location-Based Chatbot Matching & Talk System

scripts.dev:stage-zero: node scripts/reset-dev-data.js && IINPUBLIC_STAGE_SEED=stage-zero DEV_GUN_FRESH=1 npm run dev
scripts.dev:relay-only: set -a; [ -f .env.local ] && . ./.env.local; set +a; RELAY_ONLY_HUB=1 STAR_SERVER_PERSISTENCE=ephemeral E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 tsx watch src/server/index.ts
scripts.dev:p0-talks: concurrently "webpack serve --mode development --config webpack.config.js" "tsx watch src/server/index.ts"
scripts.dev:embedded-node: set -a; [ -f .env.local ] && . ./.env.local; set +a; IINPUBLIC_EMBEDDED_NODE=1 IINPUBLIC_LOCAL_PORT=8088 IINPUBLIC_WEB_ROOT=dist/web tsx src/node-app/embedded-node.ts
scripts.build:embedded: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build:embedded && cd platforms/desktop && npm install && npm start
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build:embedded && cd platforms/desktop && npm install && npm run dist
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server && npm run build:android
scripts.test:all: npm run test:type && npm run lint && jest --forceExit && PW_WORKERS=${PW_WORKERS:-20} npm run test:e2e:parallel && npm run test:e2e:heavy
scripts.health: npm run test:type && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.test:unit+e2e: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: set -a; [ -f .env.local ] && . ./.env.local; set +a; npm run build:server && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:parallel: set -a; [ -f .env.local ] && . ./.env.local; set +a; npm run build:server && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 E2E_SKIP_HEAVY=1 PW_WORKERS=${PW_WORKERS:-6} DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:heavy: set -a; [ -f .env.local ] && . ./.env.local; set +a; npm run build:server && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 E2E_SKIP_FIND_SIMILAR=1 E2E_SKIP_ALL_MESH=1 PW_WORKERS=${PW_HEAVY_WORKERS:-2} DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test tests/e2e/mass tests/e2e/staged/stage4-four-user tests/e2e/staged/stage5-multi-user tests/e2e/talks-matching && npm run test:e2e:mesh && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 PW_WORKERS=1 DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test tests/e2e/staged/stage5-multi-user/find-similar-people.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:mesh: set -a; [ -f .env.local ] && . ./.env.local; set +a; npm run build:server && find tests/e2e/talks-matching -name '*.spec.ts' ! -name '02-mesh-broadcast-announce.spec.ts' -print | sort | while IFS= read -r spec; do E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 PW_WORKERS=1 DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test "$spec"; done && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 PW_WORKERS=1 DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test tests/e2e/talks-matching/02-mesh-broadcast-announce.spec.ts --grep 'find-similar broadcast' && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 PW_WORKERS=1 DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test tests/e2e/talks-matching/02-mesh-broadcast-announce.spec.ts --grep 'ipfs attachment'
scripts.test:e2e:p0-talks: npm run build:server && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 DISABLE_HMR=true PW_WORKERS=1 playwright test tests/e2e/staged/stage2-two-user/00i-p0-direct-talk-delivery.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:staged: npm run build:server && E2E_STAGE_PIPELINE=1 PW_WORKERS=1 DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:talks-matching: npm run build:server && DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test tests/e2e/talks-matching
scripts.test:e2e:three-user-talk-matrix: npm run build:server && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 DISABLE_HMR=true PW_WORKERS=1 playwright test tests/e2e/staged/stage3-three-user/15-three-user-talk-matrix.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:l3:node-discovery: npm run build:server && E2E_GUN_MEMORY_ONLY=1 DISABLE_HMR=true E2E_P2P_NODE_ENABLED=1 PW_WORKERS=1 playwright test tests/e2e/talks-matching/06-mesh-ping-with-hub-api-down.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:partial-auto: npm run build:server && DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test tests/e2e/talks-matching/05-partial-auto-answers.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:phase-d: npm run build:server && DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test tests/e2e/staged/stage1-single-user/00x-tab-sweep-smoke.spec.ts tests/e2e/staged/stage3-three-user/00t-talk-type-intake-filter.spec.ts tests/e2e/staged/stage3-three-user/00u-talk-lifecycle-stranger-match.spec.ts tests/e2e/staged/stage3-three-user/00v-creator-reply-triage-matrix.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:phase-d2: npm run build:server && DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test tests/e2e/staged/stage1-single-user/00y-chinese-ui-traversal.spec.ts tests/e2e/staged/stage1-single-user/00-ui-navigation-settings.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:phase-d4: npm run build:server && DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test tests/e2e/staged/stage3-three-user/00u-talk-lifecycle-stranger-match.spec.ts tests/e2e/staged/stage3-three-user/00w-talk-lifecycle-flow-multi-responder.spec.ts tests/e2e/staged/stage3-three-user/00z-talk-lifecycle-tag-multi-responder.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:phase-d5: npm run build:server && DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test tests/e2e/staged/stage3-three-user/00v-creator-reply-triage-matrix.spec.ts tests/e2e/staged/stage3-three-user/00ad-reply-triage-group-date.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:phase-d6: npm run build:server && DISABLE_HMR=true playwright test tests/e2e/staged/stage1-single-user/00x-tab-sweep-smoke.spec.ts tests/e2e/staged/stage1-single-user/00-ui-navigation-settings.spec.ts tests/e2e/staged/stage1-single-user/00y-chinese-ui-traversal.spec.ts tests/e2e/staged/stage2-two-user/00ae-contacts-stranger-relationship.spec.ts
scripts.android:run: npm run android:build && npm run android:install
